title: Touch your toes & around we go
brief_description: Outlines and illustrates the perceived advantages of a multicultural approach to music and movement for preschool children, in a child care environment, especially those who use English as a second language. Appropriate for Professional Development (Home Economics) at VCE level. No other credits available.
